_comment: FROZEN real-route barrier regression. Charlotte Precision Route 1I (SavedRoute 6a7e7a1c3efa45ba79c806be, 1,000 doors) hydrated from the canonical property store. This is the route whose 11.927-mile transition was traced to a decomposition barrier straddle: Ventana Ct and Quaker Rd are 2.202 mi apart in the air and 11.927 mi apart to drive, and geometric window 0 held both. Recorded road matrices below let the repair be regression-tested offline against the REAL geometry and REAL road costs, not a synthetic river.

frozen_benchmark._comment: Independently measured real road miles on the finished order. Same optimizer, same doors; only the decomposition strategy differs. Barrier repair is the reference behavior.

recorded_repair_road_costs._comment: Every road question repairBarrierWindows asked while repairing this real route, keyed by the requested point set (coordinateKey order) with real OSRM distances in miles. Replaying these offline exercises the repair against the REAL geometry and REAL road network deterministically, with no network in the test suite.
